content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Roanoke

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific thresholds—typically a combination of a degree and years of documented direct project experience. PMI provides detailed eligibility guidelines; Granite PM Academy can help clarify your qualifications.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Roanoke-focused cohorts deliver the PMI-required contact hours in an interactive format, covering the PMBOK framework, real-world scenarios, and exam-aligned content. Attend synchronously; engage directly with our certified instructors and peers.

steps_items.heading: Apply to PMI and Pay the Exam Fee
steps_items.text: Submit your formal PMP application through PMI's candidate portal, documenting your experience and education. Pay the associated exam registration fee to PMI. Our academy team guides you through the application process and confirms your eligibility before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and review sessions—to reinforce your learning. Schedule your proctored PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Our instructors remain available to address final questions and build your confidence before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, maintain the credential by earning professional development units (PDUs) throughout a standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses and webinars to help Roanoke professionals stay current in project management and renew on schedule.
